summary: A wave releases every claim it staked in one loop at wave end, so a slot whose attempt parked hours ago still reads as claimed and its records stay unreachable

per.section: Claims — an entry in flight is left alone

acceptance: the claim a slot staked is released when that slot's own attempt ends — with the ship, or with the teardown of the worktree and branch it provisioned, which moves into the slot with it — so a parked entry is unclaimed while its siblings still run and a refilling wave holds no claim for an attempt it has stopped carrying. The hazard the one wave-end site guarded goes with the per-wave teardown that created it, never by a second release site. Teardown stays serialized against the shared worktree metadata as creation is, the wave still reports surviving paths once rather than once per worktree, and the merge wall keeps whatever its site declares today. Every claim a wave staked is gone when the wave ends, as now.
